claim: Several tweezers connectors are proprietary and take only Aresis equipment: the LEMO trigger connector only the original Aresis camera cable; the DisplayPort-shaped expansion connector must never go to a monitor or TV, or the tweezers or the monitor may be permanently damaged; and the RJ45 interlock connector only the Aresis laser warning sign.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 8 (PDF page 10). Also Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 20 (PDF page 24). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. The Installation Guide adds the camera interface box's DisplayPort sockets and the unit's sync-out connector to the never-a-monitor list. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
